title: Gynecologic Emergencies: Bleeding, Ectopic Pregnancy and Assault Care

slides.title: Today's lesson
slides.body:
As an EMR you already treat shock: control bleeding, lay the patient flat, keep her warm, give oxygen. Today, as a PCP:

  1. Take a focused gynecologic history, plus your PCP functional enquiry
  2. Recognize a ruptured ectopic pregnancy and treat shock the BC way
  3. Care for a sexual assault patient: consent, evidence, documentation

Textbook: Chapter 41, PDF pages 3474–3527
slides.say: Welcome to class. As EMRs, you already know how to treat shock: control external bleeding, lay the patient flat, keep her warm, give oxygen, and move fast. Gynecologic emergencies, meaning problems of the female reproductive system, test something more: your history-taking and your judgment. The bleeding you can see may be small while the bleeding inside is large. Today: a focused gynecologic history, including the functional enquiry only PCPs must do; how to recognize a ruptured ectopic pregnancy and manage the shock with the BC Hypovolemia protocol; and how to care for a patient after a sexual assault, with consent, evidence, and careful documentation.
slides.sayZh: 欢迎来上课。作为 EMR，你们已经会处理休克：控制外出血、让病人平卧、保暖、给氧、快速转运。妇科急症，也就是女性生殖系统的问题，考验的是更深一层的东西：你的问诊和判断。看得见的出血可能很少，腹内的出血却可能很多。今天讲：有针对性的妇科问诊，包括只有 PCP 必须做的系统问诊；怎样识别破裂的异位妊娠，并按 BC 低血容量流程处理休克；以及怎样照护性侵后的病人——征得同意、保全证据、仔细记录。

slides.title: First: privacy, and look for shock
slides.body:
Is this pain life-threatening? Look for shock first.

  • Few people in the room; take the history privately
  • A teen may not want parents to hear her sexual history
  • Offer a female paramedic for the exam if one is available
  • Abnormal vaginal bleeding = a pregnancy complication until proven otherwise
  • Abdominal pain + vaginal bleeding: always assess for shock
slides.say: With a gynecologic patient, one question comes first: is this pain a sign of something life-threatening? Look for shock first. At the same time, protect her privacy. A teenager, for example, may not want her parents to hear her sexual history. Keep the number of people small, ask your questions privately, and if a female paramedic is available, offer that choice. Two rules from the book: abnormal vaginal bleeding is a pregnancy complication until proven otherwise, and any woman with abdominal pain and vaginal bleeding must be assessed for shock.
slides.sayZh: 面对妇科病人，第一个问题是：这个疼痛是不是危及生命的信号？先找休克。同时要保护她的隐私，比如青少年可能不想让父母听到她的性史。尽量减少在场人数，私下问诊；如果有女性急救员，让病人选择。书里两条规则：异常阴道出血在排除之前一律当作妊娠并发症；凡腹痛加阴道出血的女性，都必须评估有无休克。

slides.title: The questions that matter
slides.body:
• Last menstrual period: start and end dates; was it normal?
  • Could you be pregnant? Ask without judgment
  • The pill in real life: only about 91% effective
  • 3 pregnancies, 1 live birth = G3P1
  • Bleeding: colour, clots, amount (pad ≈ 30 mL, tampon ≈ 20 mL)
  • Contraception, IUD, discharge, past STIs
slides.say: The single most important question is: when was your last menstrual period? Record the start and end dates, and ask if it was normal. Then ask, kindly and without judgment, whether she could be pregnant. In real life, the pill is only about ninety-one percent effective. If she says no, ask about breast tenderness, morning sickness, or passing urine more often. Gravida is the number of pregnancies and para is the number of live births, so three pregnancies with one birth is G3P1. Ask about the bleeding: colour, clots, and amount. A pad holds about thirty millilitres and a tampon about twenty.
slides.sayZh: 最重要的一个问题是：你末次月经是什么时候？记下起止日期，并问那次是否正常。然后友善、不带评判地问她有没有可能怀孕。现实中口服避孕药的有效率只有约百分之九十一。如果她说不可能，就问有没有乳房胀痛、晨吐或尿频。孕次是怀孕次数，产次是活产次数，所以怀孕三次、生一个记作 G3P1。问出血的颜色、有无血块、量多少：一片卫生巾约装三十毫升，一根卫生棉条约二十毫升。

slides.title: Reading the pain
slides.body:
ClueThink of
One side; pain before bleedingEctopic pregnancy
Midline cramps; bleeding before painMiscarriage
Achy lower belly after a period; worse walkingPID (pelvic infection)
Started during exerciseRuptured ovarian cyst
Sudden, severe, one side, vomitingOvarian torsion
Pain into the shoulderBlood in the abdomen
slides.say: The pain itself gives you clues. Pain on one side that starts before any bleeding suggests an ectopic pregnancy. Midline cramping, with bleeding first and pain after, suggests a miscarriage. A dull ache across the lower belly that began during or after a period, and gets worse with walking, suggests PID, pelvic inflammatory disease, an infection climbing up from the cervix. Pain that began during exercise may be a ruptured ovarian cyst. Sudden, severe pain on one side with vomiting may be ovarian torsion, a twisted ovary. And pain that spreads to the shoulder can mean blood in the abdomen. These are clues, not a diagnosis.
slides.sayZh: 疼痛本身就有线索。单侧痛、先痛后出血，提示异位妊娠。中线绞痛、先出血后痛，提示流产。下腹弥漫钝痛、在经期中或经后开始、走路加重，提示 PID，即盆腔炎，一种从宫颈往上蔓延的感染。运动中开始的痛，可能是卵巢囊肿破裂。突发单侧剧痛伴呕吐，可能是卵巢扭转，也就是卵巢拧转了。疼痛放射到肩部，可能是腹腔里有血。这些是线索，不是诊断。

slides.q: A 26-year-old has sharp pain low on her left side for three hours, then light spotting. Her last period was 7 weeks ago. Pulse 112; she is pale and anxious. What is most likely?
slides.say: Let's try a case. A twenty-six-year-old has had sharp pain low on her left side for three hours, and then some light spotting started. Her last period was seven weeks ago. Her pulse is one hundred twelve, and she is pale and anxious. What is most likely? A, a heavy normal period. B, a ruptured ectopic pregnancy. C, a miscarriage. D, pelvic inflammatory disease. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来看一个病例。一名二十六岁女性左下腹锐痛三小时，之后开始少量点滴出血。她的末次月经在七周前。脉搏一百一十二，面色苍白、焦虑。最可能是什么？A，量多的正常月经；B，破裂的异位妊娠；C，流产；D，盆腔炎。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. One-sided pain that came before the bleeding, a missed period, and signs of shock all point to a ruptured ectopic pregnancy. The spotting is light, but it tells you nothing about the bleeding inside her abdomen. A is wrong because a normal period doesn't cause shock. C usually starts with bleeding, then midline cramps. D usually causes a dull ache across both sides of the lower abdomen, often after a period, with fever.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。单侧痛、先痛后出血、月经没来、还有休克征象，全都指向破裂的异位妊娠。点滴出血虽少，但完全不能反映她腹腔里的出血量。A 错，正常月经不会引起休克。C 通常先出血，再出现中线绞痛。D 通常是双侧下腹钝痛，多在月经后出现，并伴发热。

slides.title: Ectopic pregnancy: the one that kills fast
slides.body:
The one immediately life-threatening gynecologic emergency

  • Implants outside the uterus: 97% in a fallopian tube
  • The tube can't stretch, so it ruptures, often found at 6–10 weeks
  • Classic triad: missed period, new vaginal bleeding, abdominal pain
  • Only about half of patients look typical
  • Risks: PID (most common), past ectopic, pelvic surgery, smoking

Ruptured cyst, torsion, tubo-ovarian abscess: can't be told apart in the field, so treat them like an ectopic.
slides.say: Ectopic pregnancy is the one gynecologic emergency that can kill quickly. The pregnancy implants outside the uterus, in ninety-seven percent of cases in a fallopian tube. The tube can't stretch, so it ruptures and bleeds into the abdomen, often around six to ten weeks. It's the leading cause of maternal death in the first trimester. The classic triad is a missed period, new vaginal bleeding, and abdominal pain, but only about half of patients look typical. PID is the most common cause. And a ruptured cyst, a twisted ovary, or a tubo-ovarian abscess, a pus pocket on the tube and ovary, look the same in the field, so treat them all as an ectopic.
slides.sayZh: 异位妊娠是唯一能迅速致命的妇科急症。妊娠着床在子宫以外，百分之九十七在输卵管。输卵管撑不大，所以会破裂、往腹腔里出血，常在孕六到十周。它是孕早期孕产妇死亡的首要原因。经典三联征是停经、新出现的阴道出血和腹痛，但只有约一半病人表现典型。盆腔炎是最常见的原因。卵巢囊肿破裂、卵巢扭转或输卵管卵巢脓肿——即输卵管和卵巢上的脓腔——在现场看起来都一样，所以都按异位妊娠处理。

slides.title: How much blood has she lost?
slides.body:
• Blood volume ≈ 70–80 mL/kg: about 5,000 mL at 70 kg
  • Marked fast pulse + fast breathing + low BP + confusion ≈ 1,500–2,000 mL lost
  • Pulse alone is unreliable: read the whole patient
  • Pale, cool, sweaty, thirsty, restless: early shock
  • Big change from sitting to standing: presume shock

Vaginal bleeding can be light while the abdomen fills with blood.
slides.say: You can't see blood inside the abdomen, so estimate blood loss from the patient, not from the pad. An adult has about seventy to eighty millilitres of blood per kilogram, roughly five thousand millilitres at seventy kilograms. If she has a marked fast pulse, fast breathing, a low systolic pressure, and confusion, she has probably lost one and a half to two litres. The pulse alone is unreliable. Read the whole patient: pale, cool, sweaty skin, thirst, and restlessness. A significant change from sitting to standing means you presume shock. But if she's already clearly in shock, don't stand her up just to prove it.
slides.sayZh: 腹腔里的血你看不见，所以要根据病人本身而不是卫生巾来估计失血。成人血量约每公斤七十到八十毫升，七十公斤约五千毫升。如果她明显心动过速、呼吸急促、收缩压低、意识混乱，大概已失血一点五到两升。单看脉搏并不可靠。要看整体：皮肤苍白湿冷、口渴、烦躁。从坐位到站位变化明显，就推定为休克。但如果她已经明显处于休克，就别为了证明而让她站起来。

slides.title: EMR vs PCP: the BC Hypovolemia protocol
slides.body:
Use it for hypovolemia + systolic < 90 + other signs of shock; may start earlier if shock is expected.

All licence levels (EMR + PCP)

  • Control external bleeding
  • Lay the patient supine to support BP
  • Keep warm, prevent heat loss
  • Oxygen to SpO₂ ≥ 94%

PCP adds (en route or if delayed)

  • Vascular access (IV)
  • Fluid bolus 20 mL/kg, max 2 L
  • Reassess every 500 mL
slides.say: Here's the BC Hypovolemia protocol applied to a ruptured ectopic pregnancy. You use it for a patient with blood or fluid loss, a systolic under ninety, and other signs of shock, or earlier if shock is expected. The left column is what every licence level does: control any external bleeding, lay the patient supine to support her blood pressure, keep her warm, and give oxygen to keep her saturation at ninety-four percent or higher. The right column is new for you. On the way to hospital, or if there's a delay, start an IV and give twenty millilitres per kilogram, up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred millilitres.
slides.sayZh: 这是把 BC 低血容量流程用在破裂异位妊娠上。适用于有失血或体液丢失、收缩压低于九十、并有其他休克征象的病人；预计会休克时可以更早启动。左栏是各级别都做的：控制外出血，平卧以支持血压，保暖，给氧使血氧维持在百分之九十四或以上。右栏对你是新的：在去医院的路上或有延误时，开静脉，按每公斤二十毫升、最多两升补液，每五百毫升复评一次。

slides.title: Managing a suspected ectopic
slides.body:
1. Oxygen as needed; nothing by mouth, not even water
  2. Suction and an emesis bag within reach; keep her warm
  3. Pad over the vaginal area; bring used pads to hospital
  4. No internal vaginal exam, and never pack the vagina
  5. Nearest hospital with surgery; notify early
  6. Recheck vital signs often
slides.say: Now the practical steps. Give oxygen as needed, and nothing by mouth, not even water, because she may need surgery. Expect vomiting, so keep suction and an emesis bag within reach, and keep her warm. Place a pad over the vaginal area, and bring all used pads to the hospital. Don't do an internal vaginal exam, and never pack the vagina to stop bleeding; the book calls blind packing dangerous. Go to the nearest hospital that can operate, and call ahead early. Recheck her vital signs often, because only surgery can stop this bleeding.
slides.sayZh: 现在是实际处理步骤。按需给氧，禁食禁水，连水也不给，因为她可能需要手术。预料到会呕吐，把吸引器和呕吐袋放在手边，并给她保暖。在阴道口放一块护垫，用过的护垫全部带到医院。不要做阴道内检查，也绝不要填塞阴道止血，书里说盲目填塞很危险。送最近的、能做手术的医院，并尽早通知。要经常复测生命体征，因为只有手术才能止住这种出血。

slides.q: Suspected ruptured ectopic: 60 kg, BP 80/50, pulse 128. Transport is 20 minutes. What is the best PCP plan?
options: Start the IV on scene and give 2 L before moving her
Oxygen, supine, warm, transport; IV en route, up to 1,200 mL, reassess every 500 mL
Pack the vagina to slow the bleeding, then transport
Give sips of water for her thirst, and transport sitting up
slides.say: Here's a PCP decision. A sixty-kilogram woman with a suspected ruptured ectopic pregnancy has a blood pressure of eighty over fifty and a pulse of one hundred twenty-eight. Transport is twenty minutes. What's the best plan? A, start the IV on scene and give two litres before moving her. B, oxygen, supine, keep her warm, and transport; start the IV en route and give up to one thousand two hundred millilitres, reassessing every five hundred. C, pack the vagina to slow the bleeding, then transport. D, give sips of water for her thirst, and transport sitting up. Tap your answer.
slides.sayZh: 来一道 PCP 决策题。一名六十公斤、疑似异位妊娠破裂的女性，血压八十比五十，脉搏一百二十八，转运二十分钟。最佳方案是？A，在现场开静脉，输完两升再搬动；B，给氧、平卧、保暖、出发，途中开静脉，最多给一千二百毫升，每五百毫升复评；C，填塞阴道减慢出血再转运；D，她口渴就给几口水，坐位转运。点选你的答案。
slides.explain: The answer is B. BC puts the IV en route, and the bolus is twenty millilitres per kilogram: for sixty kilograms that's one thousand two hundred millilitres, reassessed every five hundred. Only surgery will stop this bleeding, so transport comes first. A wastes scene time and gives more than her dose. C is dangerous: the bleeding is inside the abdomen, and blind vaginal packing is never recommended. D is wrong because she gets nothing by mouth, and BC lays a shocked patient supine.
slides.explainZh: 答案是 B。BC 把开静脉放在转运途中，补液是每公斤二十毫升：六十公斤就是一千二百毫升，每五百毫升复评。只有手术能止住这种出血，所以转运优先。A 浪费现场时间，而且给的量超过她的剂量。C 很危险：出血在腹腔内，盲目填塞阴道从来都不推荐。D 错，她要禁食禁水，而且 BC 让休克病人平卧。

slides.title: Sexual assault: your two jobs
slides.body:
Treatlife threats, injuries, painbrief survey only
Supportlisten; don't judge or minimizeno questions about the act
Consentbefore any exam, even vitalsand before sharing information
  • Offer a male or female paramedic
  • Talk with the patient without police present; share only what they agree to
  • Book: must report for minors and seniors in long-term care; other adults choose
slides.say: After a sexual assault, you may be the first person the patient sees. You have two jobs. First, treat life threats, injuries, and pain, with only a brief survey. Second, give emotional support and act as their advocate. Don't ask about the assault itself, don't judge, and never minimize it with words like 'it could have been worse.' Ask for consent before any exam, even vital signs, and before sharing any information. Offer a male or female paramedic. If police are there, talk with the patient alone, and share only what they agree to. The textbook says reporting is required for minors and seniors in long-term care; other adults decide for themselves.
slides.sayZh: 性侵发生后，你可能是病人见到的第一个人。你有两项任务。第一，处理致命伤、外伤和疼痛，体检只做快速筛查。第二，给予情绪支持，做病人的代言人：不问侵犯经过本身，不评判，也绝不说「本来可能更糟」这类淡化的话。任何检查——连测生命体征——以及分享任何信息之前，都要先征得同意。让病人选择男或女急救员。如果警察在场，设法和病人单独谈，只转告病人同意的内容。教材说，未成年人和长期照护机构的老人必须上报；其他成年人由本人决定。

slides.title: Preserving evidence and documenting
slides.body:
• Don't cut through clothing; don't throw anything away
  • Bloodstained items in separate paper bags, never plastic
  • Gently ask the patient not to wash, change or rinse the mouth
  • If they can't wait, respect their choice
  • Write the patient's words in quotation marks; facts only
  • "Sexual assault" is a legal diagnosis, not a medical one
slides.say: You're also at a crime scene. Collecting evidence isn't your job, but preserving it is. Don't cut through clothing, and don't throw anything away. Put bloodstained items in separate paper bags, never plastic, because mould grows in plastic and destroys the evidence. Gently ask the patient not to wash, change clothes, use hand sanitizer, urinate, or rinse their mouth, but if they can't wait, respect that. Your report is a legal document that may be used in court. Put the patient's own words in quotation marks, and record only facts: emotional state, clothing, and visible injuries. Never write a conclusion; sexual assault is a legal diagnosis, not a medical one.
slides.sayZh: 你也身处犯罪现场。取证不是你的工作，但保全证据是。不要剪穿衣物，什么都别扔。带血的物品分别装进纸袋，绝不用塑料袋，因为塑料袋里会长霉，毁掉证据。温和地请病人先不要清洗、换衣服、用免洗洗手液、排尿或漱口；但如果对方等不了，要尊重。你的报告是法律文件，可能会在法庭上使用。病人原话加引号，只记录事实：情绪状态、衣物状况和可见伤。绝不写结论；性侵是法律诊断，不是医学诊断。

slides.title: New for you as a PCP: watch out for
slides.body:
• Functional enquiry is PCP only: ask GI/GU and General Health
  • BC practical: a skipped system costs 5%, up to 15% total
  • Light vaginal bleeding ≠ small blood loss: trust the vitals
  • Ondansetron: relative contraindication in the first trimester
  • Ibuprofen, methoxyflurane: contraindicated in pregnancy
  • GHB has no antidote; naloxone won't reverse it: ventilate
slides.say: Here's what's new for you as a PCP. First, the functional enquiry is required only at PCP level. For a gynecologic complaint, the GI and GU systems, meaning digestive, urinary, and reproductive, plus general health, are directly related. On the BC practical, each system you skip costs five percent, up to fifteen percent in total. Second, light vaginal bleeding doesn't mean small blood loss; trust the vital signs. Third, check your drugs against pregnancy: ondansetron is a relative contraindication in the first trimester, and ibuprofen and methoxyflurane are contraindicated in pregnancy. Fourth, GHB, the best-known date-rape drug, has no antidote and naloxone won't reverse it, so support her breathing.
slides.sayZh: 作为 PCP，新要注意的有这些。第一，系统问诊只有 PCP 级别必须做。妇科主诉直接相关的是 GI/GU 系统——即消化、泌尿和生殖——以及一般健康。BC 实操考试中，每漏问一个系统扣百分之五，最多扣百分之十五。第二，阴道出血少不等于失血少，要相信生命体征。第三，用药要考虑怀孕：昂丹司琼在孕早期是相对禁忌，布洛芬和甲氧氟烷在孕期禁用。第四，最知名的约会强奸药 GHB 没有解药，纳洛酮也逆转不了，所以要支持她的呼吸。

slides.title: For the BC exam
slides.body:
• Book: LORDS TRACHEA or OPQRST → BC: OPQRRRST or LOTARP
  • Book: left side, or head-down → BC Hypovolemia: supine
  • Book: large-bore IV → BC: PCP only, 20 mL/kg, max 2 L, every 500 mL
  • EMRs have no IV access in BC
  • Book's opioids, midazolam, flumazenil: not on the BC EMR/PCP list
slides.say: Let's line up the book and BC, because on the exam, BC wins. For the pain history, the book uses LORDS TRACHEA or OPQRST; the BC scoring manual expects OPQRRRST or LOTARP. For position, the book keeps an ectopic patient on her left side and suggests head-down for genital bleeding; the BC Hypovolemia protocol says supine to support the blood pressure. The book asks for a large-bore IV; in BC, only the PCP starts it, giving twenty millilitres per kilogram up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred. EMRs have no IV access. And the book's opioids, midazolam, and flumazenil are not on the BC EMR or PCP list.
slides.sayZh: 把书和 BC 对照一下，因为考试以 BC 为准。疼痛问诊：书用 LORDS TRACHEA 或 OPQRST，BC 评分手册要求用 OPQRRRST 或 LOTARP。体位：书让异位妊娠病人左侧卧，生殖器出血时建议头低脚高位；BC 低血容量流程是平卧以支持血压。书要求建大口径静脉；在 BC 只有 PCP 能开，按每公斤二十毫升、最多两升，每五百毫升复评。EMR 没有静脉通路权限。书里提到的阿片类、咪达唑仑和氟马西尼都不在 BC 的 EMR 或 PCP 用药范围内。

slides.title: Three things to remember
slides.body:
1. Abdominal pain + vaginal bleeding: assess for shock; ask the LMP
  2. Suspected ectopic: supine, warm, O₂, nothing by mouth, surgical hospital; IV en route, 20 mL/kg
  3. Assault: consent first, paper bags, the patient's own words, no conclusions

Next: Chapter 42, Obstetrics
slides.say: Let's wrap up with three things to remember. One: any woman with abdominal pain and vaginal bleeding gets assessed for shock, and asked about her last menstrual period. Two: for a suspected ruptured ectopic pregnancy, lay her supine, keep her warm, give oxygen and nothing by mouth, and go to the nearest hospital that can operate. As a PCP, start the IV en route: twenty millilitres per kilogram, up to two litres, reassessing every five hundred. Three: after a sexual assault, ask consent before everything, preserve evidence in paper bags, write the patient's own words, and never write a conclusion. Next chapter: obstetrics. If anything was unclear, tap Ask. See you next class.
slides.sayZh: 收尾三句话。一，凡腹痛加阴道出血的女性都要评估休克，并问末次月经。二，疑似异位妊娠破裂：平卧、保暖、给氧、禁食禁水，送最近能做手术的医院；作为 PCP，途中开静脉：每公斤二十毫升、最多两升，每五百毫升复评。三，性侵后：做任何事先征得同意，证据用纸袋保存，记录病人原话，绝不写结论。下一章讲产科。有不懂的点「Ask」。下节课见。
